content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization; the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so those actions would be rule violations. Resubmitting (clean, with records, or corrected) won't cure a missing auth and adds a wasted touch. With a formal denial on the table and strong documentation (0.90), a medical-necessity appeal is the only legitimate route to collect the allowed amount, and billing the patient or writing off would forfeit collectible revenue.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
